payload.title: Which hyp commit implements the one history?
payload.body: One Hypothesis per candidate commit, each against the base it starts from (b6da671 or later main). The base reads one store only, so it fails lines 2 to 10: hyp status at the repository root finds no store, a cite of another store's key is unknown, an id is ordered only within its store, and a cut replaces only the clone's root .tree. Each Experiment's rubric asks for red on base and green on the candidate. The layout is decided in the Goal body, not here: stores stay in their folders.

why: The build question of G-AKJJF8; its candidates are the run's commits.
The parent issue: the shared store layer G-1391DM built, which this Goal builds on.

payload.summary: Grill of #168 done: the problem was restated as one history per repository, with the owner's overview and Goal relations as filters (#168 rewritten). G-AKJJF8 builds it with stores kept in their folders and aliases local to a store; lines 1 to 10; Q-9R7G08 asks which commit. Nothing awaits the owner.
